page.layout: One printed page. One column of running text, with two notes in the left margin: "Fivel-gonij." beside the line "Fivel-", and "Die Dmb-landen." beside "Atque hi". The catchword "regioni" stands at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: nis, in fluminis ripâ, quâ in occasum se
vertere incipit, ad litus boreum pertinens;
quarta ab aggere interiore cognominata,
in aquilonem ab urbe vergens, rivoque
Dammonensi in cæciam ventum ab urbe
defluenti contigua; postrema cunctis
prioribus major per quina passuum millia
juxta litus idem exterius porrecta, pari-
qué fere spatio intus patescens: Fivel-
gonij Hunesgonios ad ortum sequentes in
Amasi orâ, similiter in duas divisi partes,
quarum prior xxxi vicos complexa in-
signes, nulli superiorum felicitate cedit,
tum ob terræ bonitatem, tum ob com-
moda fluminis vicini: altera vicis rarior,
quos ix tantum habet, palustri fere, &
passim humili ac uliginoso solo, in au-
strum priorem sequens, ad interiora
vergens, per quam ab ortu venientibus
iter Groningam est: eam Duerswoldiam
proprio nomine appellitant. Atque hi
sunt populi, quos nunc Vmlandes nuncu-
pamus. Cujus quidem vocabuli ἔτυμον[?] si
spectas, & si exempla intueharis in litera-
rum nostratium monumentis, non verè
proprium id nomen esse, huic tantum
regioni

page.notes: Catchword "regioni" lies at the lower right, below the last line. The Greek word "ἔτυμον" is uncertain in its accents and letters. The Greek mark is printed in italic. The note "Die Dmb-landen" is in black letter. The first word "nis," is a fragment carried over from the previous page.
